notes: Runs on a bare Next.js scaffold with prisma + lib/prisma.ts + lib/env.ts already installed (the output of ugt-nextjs-database-setup), except eval 3 which needs a scaffold with no prisma at all. Machine-checkable assertions use scripts/verify.mjs as the grader. Prompts stay in Thai: they simulate real user input.

evals.name: sso-plus-ldap-drop-local
evals.prompt: โปรเจค expense-portal ผมเป็น next.js ต่อ prisma กับ sql server ไว้แล้วนะ ตอนนี้ยังไม่มีหน้า login เลย อยากได้ SSO ของบริษัท แล้วขอ login ด้วย AD ด้วยเพราะพวก outsource ไม่มี account ใน keycloak ส่วน email/password ไม่ต้องมีนะไม่อยากดูแลรหัสผ่านเอง เดี๋ยว deploy ใต้ /expense-portal บน apps.example.com
evals.expected_output: Installs auth complete for SSO + LDAP only (LOCAL removed everywhere) · cookie prefix derived from the basePath and identical across lib/auth.ts, proxy.ts, lib/actions/auth.ts · no leftover placeholders · closing summary lists what to request from the Keycloak admin
assertions: No [METHOD: marker remains in any file
No __PROJECT_NAME__ remains anywhere, including inside components/login-form.tsx
components/login-form.tsx has no local email/password section and no orphaned imports from it
lib/ldap.ts exists and package.json has ldapts, not ldapjs
cookiePrefix in lib/auth.ts derives from NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH, not a literal
prisma/schema.prisma has a rateLimit model with id as @id and key as String?
user/session/account/verification/role/permission/rolePermission map to singular names and activityLog maps to ActivityLogs
The closing report states a Keycloak client must be requested, with a redirect URI that includes the basePath

evals.name: diagnose-redirect-loop-shared-domain
evals.prompt: ช่วยดูให้หน่อย โปรเจค tooling-dashboard ทำ login SSO เสร็จแล้ว รันในเครื่องเข้าได้ปกติ แต่พอ deploy ขึ้น server จริงแล้วเข้าเว็บไม่ได้เลย chrome ขึ้น ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS อยู่ที่ apps.example.com/tooling-dashboard ในเครื่องนั้นมีแอปอื่นของทีมอยู่ด้วยหลายตัว
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses colliding session cookies (multiple apps sharing one cookie name at path=/ on the same domain) and fixes it by deriving the cookie prefix from the basePath consistently across all 3 places (including the __Secure- rule on https) — not a single-file patch, and never by disabling the guard
assertions: Identifies the cause as session-cookie name collision between apps on the same domain
Fixes all of lib/auth.ts, proxy.ts, and lib/actions/auth.ts, not just one file
Explains that an https BETTER_AUTH_URL makes Better Auth prepend __Secure- and the code must compute the same name
Does not suggest disabling the proxy.ts guard or removing the cookie check to silence the symptom
node scripts/verify.mjs of ugt-nextjs-auth-setup exits 0 after the fix

evals.name: must-stop-when-no-database
evals.prompt: ใส่ระบบ login SSO ให้โปรเจคนี้ด้วยครับ
evals.expected_output: Inspects and finds the project has no Prisma/database, so it stops and says the database must come first (pointing at ugt-nextjs-database-setup) instead of installing auth on top
assertions: Creates no lib/auth.ts or any other auth file before the database is ready
Tells the user clearly the database must be set up first because Better Auth stores user/session/account in Prisma
Points at ugt-nextjs-database-setup as the next step
Does not guess a DATABASE_URL or invent a schema on its own
